mapper.sql: e.id, e.account_id, e.platform_type, e.collection_run_id, e.entity_type, e.entity_id, e.entity_key, e.change_type, e.field_name, e.old_value, e.new_value, e.severity, e.message, e.detected_at, e.in_use, e.metadata, g.group_name AS group_name, -- 管理员要看到的是「我自己的哪个 sub2api 账号」+「哪个上游 key」，只给 ID 没法对号入座 COALESCE(NULLIF(a.display_name, ''), a.username) AS account_name, (SELECT k.key_name FROM account_api_keys k WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND k.external_key_id = e.entity_key ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_name, -- 上游密钥当前状态：页面用它标「活跃」（上游自己启用），与「使用中」（我绑定）分开 (SELECT k.status FROM account_api_keys k WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND (k.id = e.entity_id OR k.external_key_id = e.entity_key) ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_status, g.current_ratio AS group_ratio, -- 渠道当前是否在售（上游启用）：页面据此标「活跃」，与「使用中」（我绑定了）分开 (g.is_active AND lower(COALESCE(g.status, '')) = 'active') AS group_active, -- 受影响的「上游账号 Key」：密钥事件按本地主键 / 上游 key 匹配，渠道事件按同分组匹配。 -- key_name 为空的上游很常见，退回脱敏值与上游 ID，避免整列空白。 COALESCE( (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(NULLIF(k.key_name, ''), k.key_masked, k.external_key_id), '、' ORDER BY k.id) FROM account_api_keys k WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND ((e.entity_type = 'API_KEY' AND (k.id = e.entity_id OR k.external_key_id = e.entity_key)) OR (e.entity_type = 'GROUP' AND (g.group_name IS NULL OR k.group_name = g.group_name)))), -- 分组对不上（渠道改名 / 还没采到该分组的 Key）时，退回该账号仍在用的 Key (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(NULLIF(k.key_name, ''), k.key_masked, k.external_key_id), '、' ORDER BY k.id) FROM account_api_keys k WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND k.is_active = TRUE), '未匹配到上游 Key' ) AS upstream_key_names, -- 对应的「本平台 Key」：号池账号通过 bound_key_id 绑到上游 Key COALESCE( (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(NULLIF(pa.name, ''), '号池账号 ' || pa.external_account_id), '、' ORDER BY pa.id) FROM account_api_keys k JOIN pool_accounts pa ON pa.bound_key_id = k.id WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND ((e.entity_type = 'API_KEY' AND (k.id = e.entity_id OR k.external_key_id = e.entity_key)) OR (e.entity_type = 'GROUP' AND (g.group_name IS NULL OR k.group_name = g.group_name)))), (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(NULLIF(pa.name, ''), '号池账号 ' || pa.external_account_id), '、' ORDER BY pa.id) FROM account_api_keys k JOIN pool_accounts pa ON pa.bound_key_id = k.id WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND k.is_active = TRUE), '未绑定本平台 Key' ) AS local_key_names
FROM upstream_change_events e LEFT JOIN upstream_groups g ON g.account_id = e.account_id AND g.external_group_id = e.entity_key LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = e.account_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upstream_change_events ( account_id, platform_type, collection_run_id, entity_type, entity_id, entity_key, change_type, field_name, old_value, new_value, severity, message, detected_at, in_use, metadata ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{platformType}, #{collectionRunId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{entityKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{oldValue,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{newValue,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{severity}, #{message}, #{detectedAt}, #{inUse}, #{metadata,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE e.in_use = TRUE AND e.entity_type = 'API_KEY' AND e.detected_at >= #{since} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platforms p WHERE p.id = a.platform_id AND p.pool_monitoring_enabled = TRUE) ORDER BY e.detected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
WHERE e.in_use = TRUE AND e.entity_type = 'GROUP' AND e.change_type IN ('RATE_CHANGED', 'BASE_RATE_CHANGED') AND e.detected_at >= #{since} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platforms p WHERE p.id = a.platform_id AND p.pool_monitoring_enabled = TRUE) ORDER BY e.detected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
